title: FlashAttention-2 causal mask block triangular boundary tile miscalculation on odd sequence lengths
problem_statement:
### Issue FRONTIER-GH-0717: FlashAttention-2 causal mask block triangular boundary tile miscalculation on odd sequence lengths
Repository: `Dao-AILab/flash-attention`
Category: `Numerical Stability & Tensor Geometry`
Target File: `csrc/flash_attn/src/flash_fwd_kernel.h`

#### Problem Description
Block coordinate offset calculation in shared memory tile stores upper-triangular masked tokens into attention score.
Under high-load production execution, this defect triggers silent data corruption, deadlock, or assertion failure.

#### Concurrency & Invariant Conditions
- Precondition: Invariant validation must be enforced on physical silicon.
- Failure Mode: Reproduction fails with exit code != 0 or thread hang.
- Expected Fix Invariant: Calculate exact causal mask row limit: row_idx + seq_offset and skip tile computation if fully masked.

#### Reproduction Target
Run: `pytest tests/test_frontier-gh-0717.py -q`
expected_invariant: Calculate exact causal mask row limit: row_idx + seq_offset and skip tile computation if fully masked.
